title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES INSTITUTIONALIZING PEACE EDUCATION IN BASIC EDUCATION AND TEACHER EDUCATION

text.en:
The DepEd shall mainstream peace education in the basic
formal and non-formal education curriculum, utilizing the existing peace
education exemplars and other peace related modules, and enhance the
knowledge and capability of supervisors, teachers and non-teaching personnel on
peace education through the conduct of in service trainings.

The Commission on Higher Education (CHED) shall introduce
and mainstream peace education in teacher education.
POM& liatagram • 37002

The OPAPP, in collaboration with DeEd and CHED shall
strengthen linkage with private schools in promoting peace education.

The OPAPP, DepEd and CHED shall establish/enhance
mechanisms and appropriate funds in their respective departments to ensure the
sustained implementation of peace education in the educational system.

All issuances, rules and regulations which are inconsistent with
any provisions of this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26thday of September, in the year of
our Lord Two Thousand and Six.
Ginia th. Away;
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
